---
name: SOCYVIA Research Feedback & Feature Request
about: Suggest a research workflow, capability, or improvement for SOCYVIA.
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

## Research need or idea

Describe the research need, workflow, limitation, or improvement you would like SOCYVIA to support.

## Research context

If applicable, briefly describe the type of research or experiment where this would be useful.

Examples: computational social science, behavioral research, media research, communication, sociology, psychology, digital platforms, or another experimental context.

## Proposed improvement

What would you like SOCYVIA to do?

You do not need to propose a technical implementation. Describing the research need or desired workflow is enough.

## Why would this be useful?

Explain how this improvement could make experimentation, participant management, data collection, analysis, reproducibility, or reporting better.

## Current workaround

Are you currently solving this another way?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No
- [ ] Not applicable

If yes, briefly describe the workaround.

## Priority for your research

- [ ] Essential — prevents me from using SOCYVIA for this workflow
- [ ] Important — would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Useful — would be a helpful addition
- [ ] Experimental idea — something worth exploring

## Additional context

Add examples, screenshots, references, or other context if useful.

Please do not include participant data, credentials, API keys, access tokens, unpublished sensitive research data, or other confidential information.
